utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane, I'm glad we're finally talking about the neighborhood repair drive. I've been thinking about how we can get more people involved.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane! I was just saying we need to spread the word more—maybe we can post flyers around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure which repair drive you mean. Could you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The one you mentioned earlier about fixing the computer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah, I hear we're gathering supplies for the repair drive. Do you have a list of what's still needed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I saw a list somewhere, but um... maybe check with Sarah? She's been on top of it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea, I'll go ask Sarah then. Thanks, Noah!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? I'm not entirely sure, but I hope they've thought about parking and scheduling. It could get messy if too many people show up at once.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. Do you know if they have a plan for that?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, what's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, actually. I've heard bits and pieces but nothing concrete.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Where did you hear about it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think it's a great way to help out around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about it! I was planning to bring my toolbox—got plenty of wrenches and screwdrivers if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's awesome, Gus! I'm sure folks will really appreciate your tools. I'll be bringing some paint supplies myself.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds like a great idea! Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll add you to the list. Do you have any items in mind to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I've got a rusty old bike that could use some fixing, and maybe a broken toaster too. What else are folks bringing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you were working on the repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What makes you think I need help, Sam? Did someone send you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No, no one sent me, Kira. I just know you've been at it for a while, so I figured I'd lend a hand if you wanted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, it's good to see you! How are you doing with the repair drive preparations?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Rosa! Honestly, I've been so swamped I barely know what's happening. What do we need to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, I've got a checklist ready. Let's start with collecting the tools and materials from neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, are you going to that repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It starts at 10 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli! I was meaning to ask you about that repair drive... I think I left my toaster somewhere? Or was it a lamp?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the drive... I'm not sure about your toaster.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, maybe it was a lamp after all? I remember something about a plug... oh dear, I can't quite recall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, how's the repair drive planning going? Need any help connecting people?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I've been hearing bits and pieces around the neighborhood. Happy to spread the word if you need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great! Maybe you can let the folks on Maple Street know, and I'll handle the others.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! I'm spreading the word about the repair drive—are you in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm in! Just don't count on me being early, you know how I am.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Dane! Better late than never—just glad you're on board.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've been meaning to ask about that repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, it's coming along. I just like to have a clear schedule for these things, you know?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I get that. Do you have a timeline in mind?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I heard about the repair drive—how can I help coordinate with the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I can get a copy of the school calendar. Let's meet tomorrow to plan the drive times around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, tomorrow works. How about right after drop-off, around 9?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik! How's the repair drive going? Need any help coordinating?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's going well! I'm planning to set up a schedule this weekend. Want to help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely! I can talk to the folks on Maple Street and the community center group. Let's make sure everyone knows!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive. Need me to bring over my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's kind of you, Gus. But I'm a bit worried about coordinating everyone's schedules. When were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm free most evenings, just let me know what works for the group.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I noticed the repair drive is focusing on the older homes along Maple Street. Are you looking for a specific one?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, exactly! We've identified a handful that need urgent attention. Do you know of any specific issues on your street?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I have noticed some loose shingles on the Johnson house and a leaky spigot at the old Miller place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's wrong with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you clarify which repair drive you mean? The one for the server or the one for the old laptop?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The server one. Is it broken?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hello Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, hi Sam! I'm glad you asked. We could really use some extra hands and maybe some spare parts or tools if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I have a solid collection of tools and some spare electronics parts. Count me in to help fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've been hearing bits about a repair drive from others. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but honestly, I've been so busy I can't remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I was hoping you might have the scoop. Maybe we can ask around together?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? Are you sure that's actually going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard from Linda that they've already fixed three cars with it! Seems promising.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Three cars? That's convenient. Did you see any of them yourself?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, any news on that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Haven't heard much. Just hoping it gets done soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, me too. I'll keep an ear out while I'm out and about.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Leo! Are we still on for that repair drive this weekend? I hope I remembered the date right.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, this weekend works for me. What time?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Let's say around 10 in the morning? That way we have the whole day ahead of us.
